newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil exchanges shares in Hafslund.
newsitem.headline: Statoil exchanges shares in Hafslund.

text.p: State Norwegian oil company Den norske stats oljeselskap AS said on Tuesday it had exchanged 2.69 million B shares in power company Hafslund ASA for an equivalent number of A shares.
Statoil now has 16.7 percent of voting shares in Hafslund, which was demerged from drugs group Nycomed ASA last May.
"It is our intention to focus on the energy market, which makes this (Hafslund) interesting," Statoil spokesman Kai Nilsen told Reuters.
Market sources said Statoil had exchanged shares with many small investors, including several fund holders. Statoil declined to comment on how much it had paid for the exchange.
"I have no comment on what deal we had with those we bought from," Nilsen said.
